D: Piṇḍeti，（piṇḍ + e），弄成团，混合，收缩。 【过】 ~esi。 【独】 piṇḍetvā。（p226）
C: piṇḍeti：[piṇḍ + e] balls together； contracts； mixes．
P: Piṇḍeti，[denom．fr．pinḍa] to ball together，mix，put together Pv．II，952 （=pisana-vasena yojeti PvA．135）．‹-› pp．piṇḍita．（Page 458）
I: piṇḍeti：To roll into a lump； to assemble
U: PIṆḌETI：（piṇṇ+e） gom chung lại，trộn lại，tiếp xúc với [aor] --esi [abs] --piṇṇetvā
DOP: piṇḍati piṇḍeti ~ayati, pr. 3 sg. [ S. Dhātup piṇḍate, piṇḍayati, Wg §§ 8:21, 32:130 ], gathers; heaps; counts, reckons; Dhātup 569 (piṇḍa saṅghāte); Dhātum 150 (piḍi saṅghāta-ādisu); 801; Pv 21:53 (Aṅkurassa mahādāne vidhā ~enti nāriyo; cf Pv-a 135, 7 : ~entī ti piṃsanavasena yojenti, Ce so; Ee pisana-; Be, Ee pisanavasena payojenti); Sadd 356, 8 (piḍi saṅghāte: … ~ati piṇḍo); 533, 17 (piḍi saṅghāte: ~eti ~ayati piṇḍo); — absol. piṇḍetvā, Mhv 36:108; Sadd 64, 26 (tāni sabbāni ~etvā); 803, 10 (saṅkhyānan ti piṇḍagaṇanā, saṅkalanapaṭuppannādinā ~etvā gaṇanā ti attho); — pp piṇḍita , mfn. 1. [ ts ] rolled into a ball; collected, gathered; massed together; added together, counted; Abh 1073 (~aṃ gaṇite); Thī 395 (vividhā cakkhuvidhā ca ~ā, Be, Ce, Ee so; Se maṇḍitā; Thī-a 240, 25 : ~ā ti samuditā); Ja III 76, 8 (te sīhabhayatajjitā nivattitvā ~ā aṭṭhaṃsu, Be, Ce, Ee so; Se piṇḍikā); Ap 488, 26 ( in uddāna: tīṇi gāthāsatān’ ettha bāsaṭṭhi c’ eva ~ā); Nidd-a I 253, 19 (sannipatitan ti ~aṃ); Sadd 14, 19 (sabbāni tāni ~āni chanavutividhāni); — 2. [ BHS id. ], rounded; compact; Abh 1073 (~aṃ … ghane); Ja II 439, 8´ (bindussaro ti bindunā avisaṭena ~ena sarena samannāgato); VI 519, 6´ (bindussarā ti ~-ssarā).
